name: English - English for Automotive Engineers C1
description:
This module focuses on English-language communication and technical vocabulary in the automotive industry. Classes are arranged thematically around automotive topics of interest, such as the engine, electric cars, driverless cars, etc.

The module includes opportunities for students to practice both written and oral communication needed in professional life, with emphasis on soft skill areas such as meetings, information acquisition, presentations, team collaboration, and reports, as well as aspects of intercultural communication needed for achieving professional success.
prerequisites: Ability to begin work at the C1 level as evidenced by the placement test at www.moodle.tum.de.
